Your holdings: SMCI (-44.1%), SOXL (-80.77%), and MUU (-64.16%) are deep in the red and need serious attention. Your leveraged ETFs are getting crushed, and margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia (NVDA) news and any potential follow-through in the chip sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your biggest losers and the leveraged decay.
plays: Trim SOXL and MUU if any bounce occurs to reduce decay and margin risk.
Consider trimming SMCI if it shows any signs of weakness.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
